$schema: ZEROX·SIGNALS design tokens — extracted from public/simple-signals.html
name: neon-obsidian

usage.gradient: Reserved for signature moments only: the active bottom-nav tab and the primary CTA (Ask ZEROX). Do not apply to every active filter chip — that flattens its impact.
usage.emerald_vs_red_vs_amber: Up = emerald (teal-shifted, not pure green), down/danger = red (magenta-shifted), caution = amber (orange). Chosen for deuteranopia/protanopia separation; always pair with a redundant cue (▲/▼ or explicit label), never color alone.

elevation.description: Three-tier shadow system. Dense repeated list items (calls, dex cards, heat bubbles, PNL tiles) default to the cheap flat tier so attention isn't spread evenly across dozens of identical cards — only live/up-trending items and one-off feature cards (paycard, askcard, tgcard) earn the glow tier.

roles.mono: All data — prices, multipliers, tickers, timestamps, labels. Carries the terminal/trading-desk identity.
roles.sans: Prose only — coin names, descriptions, notes.

breakpoint_px.note: simple-signals.html is a mobile-first single-column fluid layout by design (CSS Grid auto-fill, no fixed breakpoints needed at this size). These values are the convention to reuse if/when it grows a tablet/desktop layout, matching the split already planned between Simple Signals (mobile) and the ZEROX Terminal (desktop, signals.html/pro-signals.html).

motion.tab_switch: one fade + 6px rise, 220ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1), respects prefers-reduced-motion
motion.press_feedback: scale(.94–.985) on :active across all tappable cards/chips/buttons
motion.hover_lift: translateY(-1px to -2px), gated behind @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) so it never sticks on touch
